author: Tynvale
body:
The heading says it all!

I need ideas that would be easy to make, enjoyable to watch and not an AMA/QnA since I am doing that for 500 subs!

If I were to reach 500 subs before I make the 100th video, I would combine both the 100th video special and the 500 sub special together!

So please go ahead and give me any ideas you have...
